name: Paneer Tikka
instructions: Cut paneer into cubes. Mix yogurt, spices, and salt to prepare the marinade. Add paneer, capsicum, and onion and coat well. Marinate for 20 minutes. Grill or pan-fry until golden and slightly charred. Serve hot with chutney.

name: Veg Biryani
ingredients: basmati rice, carrot, beans, peas, onion, spices
instructions: Wash and soak basmati rice. Cook vegetables with onion and spices. Add soaked rice and water. Cook until the rice is tender and fluffy. Let it rest for a few minutes and serve hot with raita.

name: Chicken Biryani
ingredients: chicken, basmati rice, onion, tomato, yogurt, spices
instructions: Marinate chicken with yogurt, spices, ginger, garlic, and salt. Cook the chicken with onions and tomatoes. Prepare partially cooked basmati rice. Layer the rice over the chicken and cook on low heat until completely done. Mix gently and serve hot.

name: Pasta Alfredo
ingredients: pasta, cream, butter, garlic, parmesan cheese, pepper
instructions: Boil pasta until tender and drain. Melt butter in a pan and sauté garlic. Add cream and parmesan cheese and stir until creamy. Add cooked pasta and mix well. Season with pepper and serve hot.

name: Chicken Pasta
ingredients: pasta, chicken, tomato, onion, garlic, spices
instructions: Boil pasta and keep aside. Cook chopped chicken with spices until done. Sauté onion, garlic, and tomato in another pan. Add chicken and pasta and mix everything well. Cook for a few minutes and serve hot.

name: Veg Fried Rice
ingredients: rice, carrot, beans, capsicum, spring onion, soy sauce
instructions: Cook and cool the rice. Heat oil in a pan and stir-fry vegetables. Add cooked rice and soy sauce. Mix well on high heat. Add spring onions and serve hot.

name: Chicken Noodles
ingredients: noodles, chicken, carrot, capsicum, cabbage, soy sauce
instructions: Boil noodles and drain. Cook chicken pieces until done. Stir-fry vegetables in a hot pan. Add noodles, chicken, and soy sauce. Toss everything together and cook for a few minutes. Serve hot.

name: Masala Dosa
ingredients: rice, urad dal, potato, onion, curry leaves, spices
instructions: Prepare dosa batter using soaked rice and urad dal. Ferment the batter. Prepare potato masala with onion and spices. Spread batter thinly on a hot pan. Add potato masala, fold the dosa, and serve with chutney and sambar.

name: Palak Paneer
ingredients: paneer, spinach, onion, tomato, cream, spices
instructions: Blanch spinach and blend into a smooth puree. Sauté onion, tomato, and spices. Add spinach puree and cook for a few minutes. Add paneer cubes and cream. Simmer gently and serve hot with rice or roti.

name: Chicken Curry
ingredients: chicken, onion, tomato, ginger, garlic, spices
instructions: Heat oil and sauté onions until golden. Add ginger, garlic, tomatoes, and spices. Cook until the oil separates. Add chicken pieces and mix well. Add water and cook until the chicken is completely tender. Serve hot with rice or roti.
